title: Every derived cache key holds the form of the rule that made it
goal: kb/_self/code.md states that a cache of derived results carries a form constant of the rule that produced it in its key (as PROJECTION_FORM and SCAN_FORM do), and a test finds a cache key without one. Answers BG-ke2xj34l, where a leak verdict cached under a laxer scan rule could be reused.
